title: Solar radial velocity
description: Sun-as-a-star Level 2 radial velocity from NEID and EXPRES, in meters per second (issue #76, ADR 0037). The value is archive ccfrvmod converted from km/s. NEID uncertainty is dvrms, also from km/s. EXPRES uncertainty is e_v, from cm/s, because a 2024-09-30 sample showed dvrms matched e_v rather than the TAP km/s label. Null velocities are omitted. A gap is not filled. The table keeps 14 days. EXPRES on the archive ended 2026-04-25 when checked on 2026-11-05, so this panel can show NEID alone until a newer EXPRES day is published. Narrow window: one full-width row. Below 640 px the page is tall, and Grafana's own menu can crowd a 320 px window. This is the internal view.

panels.title: Radial velocity
panels.description: Meters per second. NEID and EXPRES are separate series. spanNulls is off, so a missing exposure is a break.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_tag AS "time",
  rv_m_s AS "NEID"
FROM solar_rv
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND instrument = 'neid'
  AND rv_m_s IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_tag AS "time",
  rv_m_s AS "EXPRES"
FROM solar_rv
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND instrument = 'expres'
  AND rv_m_s IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1
